sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio
Morning debrief with night shift regarding early-morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; gearing up for deployment and patrols.
Check-in Corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check — all clear:
Check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square — full sweep, all clear.
Walkthrough Bledisdoe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center — all clear.
Check-in Commercial Bay — full sweep, all clear.
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint.
Check-in Corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane — all clear.
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street — all clear:
Check-in Corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St — all clear.
Check-in Corner of Rutland St and Wakefield St — all clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Check-in Auckland Town Hall — all clear.
Welfare check Acceco Supermarket — interrupted by response call.
Response call from W Cosmetics regarding a shoplifter in store; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at the response call; staff pointed out her last-seen direction down towards Britomart.
Scanned the area; a member of the public said she got onto the Inner Link red bus.
Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding two individuals arguing in-store near the toilet area; assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call together with Police; staff pointed out they had left heading towards Lower Albert St. Staff member was frightened for the female.
Response call from W Cosmetics — the female individual is spotted walking into Lush; assistance requested to intercept her.
Spotted the female sitting outside Opsm trying to sell stolen items. When approached she tried to claim she had bought them; items were taken back and she was given a verbal trespass.
Returned items back to W Cosmetics.
Standing by to show presence in case she tries to come back.
Check-in Corner of Darby St and Queen St — all clear.
Check-in Top of Victoria Street and Federal St — all clear.
Response call from Jo&Joe regarding a male individual inside the lobby area; assistance requested to move him along (welfare check interrupted).
While en route, received call back from Jo&Joe that the individual had left; stood down.
Returning to routes. Welfare check — all clear:
Response call from Jo&Joe — the individual is back inside the lobby area.
Arrived; the individual had already left. As he is a nuisance, standing by until he circles back to have a word with him.
While on standby, received response call from W Cosmetics — female thief in all black, last seen heading through Durham Street West.
Tried to intercept the individual but she was nowhere to be seen. Retrieving photo from staff at W Cosmetics. (photo on file)
Resuming Echo Route; standing by at W Cosmetics due to repeated hits on the store over the last few hours.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Afternoon shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:39 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone
Response call from Vans Queen Street — gathering information on a pestering individual who has repeatedly bothered their staff. To be uploaded to Auror and spoken to about leaving the store alone.

While retrieving information from Vans, received response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a suspicious male individual inside the store; assistance requested to stand by in case he steals. Guards split and Guard Two attended the call.
Linked up with the second guard at Mountain Warehouse, standing by for the individual inside the fitting room, waiting for him to exit the store.

Response call from Farmers Queen Street regarding a male individual in a green beanie, black Huffer hoodie and grey Nike shorts who stole a Jimmy Choo red set; last seen heading up Queen Street — keep an eye out.
The individual from Mountain Warehouse headed out; approached him to check his bag, found items inside and returned goods staff estimated at $400–500.
Individual left the store and is lingering outside Kathmandu and Macpac; standing by in case he attempts to steal from these stores as well.
Individual left and got onto the Inner Link red bus. Leaving standby.
Response call from W Cosmetics — the same female from this morning is back and has stolen makeup items.
Arrived and traced her to Nike; retrieved the stolen items.
Check-in Corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check — all clear:
Haus of Gelato Cafe Wellesley Street West
Response call from staff regarding a sleeper in front of the 220 entrance.
Arrived and woke the individual, asking him to move along. The individual is known as Angel.
Angel is slowly leaving; he is under the influence of narcotics, slow to react and get up. Giving him time to gather himself and move along.
Individual has moved along. Returning to routes.
Check-in Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square — all clear.
Walkthrough Bledisdoe building alleyway — all clear.
Tony's Original Steakhouse and Seafood Restaurant
Welfare check Skymart Convenience Store — all clear.
Response call from Celine Mediterranean Cuisine regarding several individuals bunched up on the side of the store; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived and the group had already disbanded. Commencing route again through Queen Street.
Welfare check Durham Street East and West alleyway and businesses within both vicinities — all clear.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and stores within the vicinity — all clear.
Heading back to headquarters to conduct mandatory building sweep.
Building checks completed; returning to routes.
Welfare check Imperial Lane, building sweep around the area — all clear.
Welfare check Queens Arcade — all clear.
Check-in Commercial Bay — full sweep, all clear.
Check-in Corner of Shortland St and Queen St — all clear.
Check-in Top of Victoria Street and Federal St — all clear.
Check-in Corner of Darby St and Queen St — all clear.
Walkthrough Bledisdoe building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center — all clear.
Welfare check Top of Mayoral Drive — all clear.
Response call from Jo&Joe regarding a male individual who needs moving along.
While en route, received call back to stand down — the individual had left.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to Night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:35 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone
Patrolling down Queen Street, conducting welfare checks along the way.
Welfare check Q Convenience Store on Queen St — all clear.
Full sweep around Commercial Bay and Britomart Station — all clear.
Standby in Commercial Bay for any nearby calls and showing presence.
Continuing route, patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check Albert Mart and Japanese restaurant — all clear.
Welfare check Karaoke Bar and Sky Mart Convenience Store — all clear.
Welfare check Wellesley Street and Mayoral Drive — all clear.
Full sweep around Aotea Square — all clear.
Standby at Aotea Square for any nearby calls and showing presence.
Received response call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a vagrant male sitting inside their store for a long time, not buying anything and being distracting towards customers.
Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's; the vagrant male was still sitting inside. Informed him of the situation and he complied, walking out of the store without any further issues. (video on file)
Standby in front of Queen St McDonald's to show presence in case the vagrant male comes back.
Welfare check Victoria St and top High Street.
Full sweep around Freyberg area and Chancery Square — all clear.
Standby at Freyberg Square for any nearby calls and showing presence.
Patrol through Connel Street, bottom of High St, Fort St and Jo&Joe — all clear.
Welfare check Gore St and Auckland Harbour Suites — all clear.
Welfare check Britomart and Commercial Bay — all clear.
Welfare check carpark next to Chemist Warehouse — all clear.
Patrol Upper Queen Street — all clear.
Welfare check Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive — all clear.
Welfare check 77Convenience Store on Victoria Street — all clear.
Welfare check Albert Mart Convenience Store — all clear.
Welfare check Customs St and Custom Mart Convenience Store — all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane, Fort St and Jo&Joe — all clear.
Welfare check High St and High Street Supermarket — all clear.
Welfare check Chancery Square, Freyberg area and Upper High Street — all clear.
Welfare check Lorne St and Auckland Library — all clear.
Received a call from Britomart McDonald's regarding two suspicious males inside their store; the manager told them to leave but they refused.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's; the two suspicious males had left the store.
Standby in front of Britomart McDonald's to show presence.
Patrol Fort Lane, Fort St and the bottom of High St — all clear.
Welfare check High St Supermarket — all clear.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square — all clear.
Welfare check bottom of Hobson St — all clear.
Welfare check 77Convenience Store on top of Victoria Street — all clear.
Patrol down Victoria St towards Queen St and Lorne St — all clear.
